headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: The management expects stronger ARR growth and improved PBT and PAT in H2FY27, as seasonal demand offsets higher interest and depreciation expenses.

We have broadly maintained our earnings estimates for FY27E/FY28 and reiterate BUY with a TP of Rs134, assigning 11x EV/EBITDA on FY28E.  Good show on key operating metrics: Net sales increased by 7.4% YoY to Rs1,797Mn in Q2 FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA grew 10.8% YoY to Rs543Mn at a 30.2% margin.
PAT declined 9.7% YoY to Rs146Mn at an 8.1% margin due to higher depreciation of Rs229Mn and interest of Rs108Mn.Owned hotels recorded 94% occupancy in Q2 FY27 compared to 93% in Q2 FY26.
valuation: We have broadly maintained our earnings estimates for FY27E/FY28 and reiterate BUY with a TP of Rs134, assigning 11x EV/EBITDA on FY28E.  Good show on key operating metrics: Net sales increased by 7.4% YoY to Rs1,797Mn in Q2 FY27.
Further, at current price, the stock is available at attractive valuation, which further strengthens our investment rationale.
Driven by an asset-light strategy, the FY31 target mix comprises 4,905 managed keys, 2,112 owned keys, and 483 leased keys.
watch: Further, it identified strong structural tailwinds across key demand segments, noting the Indian wedding industry is expanding at a 14.3% CAGR and MICE is growing at 10% to 13%.
The company outlined a roadmap to scale the portfolio to 100 hotels and 7,500 keys by FY31 by adding 57 hotels and 4,771 keys.
